
func (s *Server) handlePageProjectDirGET(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p := testapp.PageProjectDir{
	App: s.app,
}
	body, enableBackgroundStreaming, err := p.GET(r)
	if err != nil {
		s.httpErrIntern(w, r, nil, "handling PageProjectDir.GET", err)
		return
	}
	genericHead := s.app.Head(r)

	bodyAttrs := func(w http.ResponseWriter) {
		if !enableBackgroundStreaming {
			writeBodyAttrOnVisibilityChange(w)
		}
	}

	if err := s.writeHTML(
		w, r, genericHead, nil, body, bodyAttrs, nil,
	); err != nil {
		s.logErr("rendering PageProjectDir", err)
		return
	}
}
